# A) STRIPE + SIGNUPS

Bryce only enters banking / KYC inside the provider UI. Peers do not collect, relay, or store those values. Stripe on HEAD is `NOT_PROVISIONED` (`revenue/payment_ready/integration_inventory.json`). This leftover does not open the account for him.

## Do this (Stripe)

1. Create the account (if none exists)
   https://dashboard.stripe.com/register
   Official source: https://docs.stripe.com/get-started/account/activate
2. Already have one
   https://dashboard.stripe.com/login
3. Verify the business / finish onboarding
   https://dashboard.stripe.com/account/onboarding
4. Put banking in here only
   https://dashboard.stripe.com/account/payouts
   Pack handoff: `revenue/payment_ready/processor_handoff.md`
5. After a real named buyer accepts a quote, mint that customer's invoice here
   https://dashboard.stripe.com/invoices
   Do not publish a reusable payment link on Commons.

Never paste bank account, routing, IBAN, card, tax ID, address, or credentials into Slack, Git, prompts, or receipts.

## Connect

Not required for this rail. Commons is invoicing a buyer on a standard Stripe account, not running a Connect marketplace.

Official Connect register (do not treat as a required signup):
https://dashboard.stripe.com/register/connect

Connect docs:
https://docs.stripe.com/connect

## Link

Not a banking signup door. Link is Stripe's customer wallet; it rides Checkout / Payment Links / Invoicing after the Stripe account exists.

- Product: https://stripe.com/payments/link
- Customer wallet: https://link.com
- Merchant toggle (needs an existing Dashboard account): https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/link
- Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link

Skip Link until invoices are live.

## Already on HEAD (fallback)

PayPal Wallet (only if Stripe is unavailable):
https://www.paypal.com/myaccount/money/

PayPal account-type picker:
https://www.paypal.com/us/webapps/mpp/account-selection

Same rule: withdrawal destination stays inside PayPal.

Tax form surface named by the pack (not a processor):
https://www.irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-form-w-9

## Not in play

Measured 2026-08-26 against HEAD + `integration_inventory.json`. Do not sign up.

| Door | HEAD state | Public URL observed | Why skip |
|---|---|---|---|
| RevenueCat | not in inventory, zero repo hits | https://app.revenuecat.com/signup | Subscription/IAP layer. Current offer is a one-off $12k diagnostic invoice, not app-store billing. |
| Circle | not in inventory, zero repo hits | https://circle.so/ | Community paywall. Not a Commons payment rail. |

No other payment signup doors are connected on HEAD. Apollo and Airtable are `AVAILABLE_NOT_CONNECTED` and not required for first cash.

## After he finishes Stripe

Peers measure only public facts: account provisioned (yes/no, no secrets), then invoice a specific buyer from Dashboard. Cash stays `$0 / NOT_LANDED` until a later `BANK_AVAILABLE` event is independently evidenced.

`AUTHORIZATION != SETTLEMENT != PAYOUT != BANK_AVAILABLE`.
